Staff rotas on an industrious shift
This page shows new staff why the Companion Animal Travel Desk matters to Aurelia Skyways, because careful handling protects comfort, safety, and trust. You must listen closely to each booking note, check documents with patience, and speak in a calm, reassuring way. When a customer arrives worried about a pet, our duty is to reduce distress and prevent avoidable delay. The senior coordinator reviews difficult cases, but you should still gather the facts cleanly and escalate concerns without drama. If a large dog is mentioned, <<FACT F075>> Remember to confirm the crate, the route, and any service limits before you promise a result. For birds, <<FACT F065>> If information is unclear, apologise promptly and seek guidance rather than guessing. Milolet or any other animal should be treated with the same care, because every family expects humane service and honest answers. Keep your tone respectful, keep records accurate, and remember that steady attention is the best support you can give.
